scripts.dev: npm run migrate:deploy && concurrently -n server,front -c blue.bold,green.bold "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix front"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix front run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix front run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix front run test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix server run test:coverage && npm --prefix front run test:coverage
